title: SAGA: Domain-Matched Predictor Adaptation and Off-the-Shelf Audio-Visual Synchrony Scoring for Deepfake Attribution (code)
description: Reference implementation accompanying the manuscript "SAGA: Domain-Matched Predictor Adaptation and Off-the-Shelf Audio-Visual Synchrony Scoring for Deepfake Attribution", submitted to Applied Artificial Intelligence. Includes domain-matched real-only cross-modal predictor adaptation, error-curve and SyncNet feature extraction, the RF-300 / Logistic Regression / Hybrid BiLSTM classifiers, and the evaluation scripts (closed-set, identity-disjoint, open-set, significance, latency). Datasets (FakeAVCeleb, DF-TIMIT, LAV-DF) are not redistributed.
